build_stack_s_matrix: build a python module that stacks multiple layer solve results into a combined scattering matrix using fmmax.scattering.stack_s_matrix
test_prepend_layer: test prepending a single layer to an existing scattering matrix using fmmax.scattering.prepend_layer
build_interior_s_matrices: build a python module that computes interior scattering matrices for each layer using fmmax.scattering.stack_s_matrices_interior
test_redheffer_star_product: test combining two scattering matrices via the Redheffer star product using fmmax.scattering.redheffer_star_product
refactor_set_layer_thickness: refactor the scattering matrix to adjust start or end layer thickness using fmmax.scattering.set_start_layer_thickness and set_end_layer_thickness
